20168.long_desc:
A professional 20.1 inch LED Backlight monitor with 4:3 viewing ratio, our slimline Arcooda model is designed for desktop use. It offered custom metal frame with glass panel, VESA mount (8 x M4*12), and supports 15khz, 24khz, 31khz, and up to 1600 x 1200 UXGA resolution (can also accept 1080P) via VGA and HDMI inputs. 1.9ms response time, match up with the desktop frame for perfect solution for retro gaming. Now with audio output. This is the LED Backlight version. Get arcade ready with the 20.1 Inch LED Backlight Arcade Monitor which features a premium LG A grade panel with 4:3 resolution, making it perfect for your old-school 15khz / 24khz /31khz arcade games as well as offering the ability to run the latest arcade games in high definition (supports 1080p with display at 1600 x 1200). Highly suitable for desktop and home gaming applications. This monitor is the updated Arcooda 20inch model (our old model #17750 V18 firmware), where we have introduced new features, added extra harness and updated the firmware which is now version 30. Key features of the LED Backlight monitor are; - VGA & HDMI input, for RGB input, please use the Arcooda RGB Board - video input support: 15khz, 24khz, 31khz, and up to 1600 x 1200 UXGA resolution at low monitor lag - Audio output support: connect your HDMI input into the Arcooda 20.1 inch arcade LCD monitor, then connect your 3.5mm audio jack out of the monitor into your audio system. - many monitor firmware adjustments have been made including fine tuning options and supporting EGA games such as Sega Model 2/3 game series. Due to the slimline custom metal frame with glass, this product is only suitable for desktop or wall mount use (via VESA mounts (8 x M4*12)). If you want to use the same specifications monitor inside your arcade cabinet, please consider our #20135 20.1 Arcooda LCD Monitor.

Please Note: Desktop monitor stands are not included. Please review below monitor stand options; #20138 Standard Desktop Stand #20137 Rotating Desktop Stand with vertical lift function
